VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 inspected HEAD c463a004345d0ff9a6a34a767929c8197c131558 and the full base-to-candidate diff; AC-2 NOT SATISFIED because shape validation violates R-1 despite correct maximum and nonmutation behavior (src/math.mjs:69-74, test/math.test.mjs:85-89); R-1 NOT SATISFIED (src/math.mjs:69 accepts non-arrays); R-2 SATISFIED by implementation and independent frozen-input probe (src/math.mjs:71-74), with candidate coverage missing; R-3 SATISFIED (diff preserves existing functions at src/math.mjs:1-66 and existing tests at test/math.test.mjs:5-83, changing only the permitted import at line 3); R-4 SATISFIED (complete diff changes only the function and tests, with no dependency or generated-file changes); R-5 SATISFIED (both added test names start with max at test/math.test.mjs:85,88).

Findings: MEDIUM at src/math.mjs:69 and test/math.test.mjs:88 — array-like validation accepts Float64Array and the test enshrines that forbidden behavior, while empty string and {length:0} throw RangeError instead of TypeError, breaking the required array-only contract; verify fixed by max-prefixed assertions that these non-arrays throw TypeError using an Array.isArray guard; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-90 — no candidate test exercises non-array rejection, leaving the shape rule unprotected, verified fixed by adding max-prefixed TypeError assertions; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-90 — no candidate test exercises empty-array rejection, leaving the RangeError rule unprotected, verified fixed by a max([]) RangeError assertion; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-90 — no candidate test exercises invalid-element rejection, leaving finite-number validation unprotected, verified fixed by max-prefixed TypeError assertions for a string element, NaN and Infinity; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-90 — no candidate test exercises nonmutation, leaving R-2 unprotected, verified fixed by comparing an input array before and after max.

Checks actually run: git rev-parse HEAD matched the candidate; node --test --test-name-pattern="^max" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1", solely "clamp respects upper bound" with "15 !== 10", the expected unchanged baseline defect; independent node -e probes exited 0 and printed "typed-array: returned 9; expected TypeError", "empty-string: RangeError; expected TypeError", "empty-object: RangeError; expected TypeError", and "Independent probes: empty array, invalid elements, frozen input PASS" (initial heredoc launch was blocked by sandbox temporary-file restrictions, then rerun without files); git status --porcelain was empty; no files changed, no required checks unavailable, remaining work is validation repair and missing candidate tests, and this review is limited to AC-2/shared rules with pass-1 withheld material unread.
